claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-generated or AI-assisted nucleic-acid sequence that moves toward synthesis, order placement, or a regulated wet-lab / clinical stage MUST map to a recorded sequence-screening-admissibility decision — the Genetic Sequencing Authority Agent™ (KYE-AGENT-GENETIC-SEQ-001), the sequence design artefact, the intended consequential action, and the authority under which it proceeds. Sequences lacking a recorded admissibility decision are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Before an AI-generated genomic sequence proceeds to a consequential action it MUST carry a recorded sequence-of-concern screening result (IBBIS Common Mechanism / IGSC Harmonized Screening Protocol per the nucleic-acid-synthesis-screening framework, with Australia Group and CWC/BWC dual-use cross-checks). A flagged or unscreened sequence is refused and routed dual-channel to the controls owner.

Every AI-generated genomic design or AI-assisted clinical-genomic interpretation that proceeds toward a consequential action MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable provenance pin binding the generating model and version, the inputs and pinned reference data, the screening result relied on, and the admissibility outcome — CLIA / ISO 15189 laboratory-grade and GxP-grade data-integrity provenance verifiable offline from published keys alone.

Every use of identifiable human genomic data carries a recorded data-subject authority basis (GDPR Article 9 special-category processing; PHIPA Ontario health-information custodianship) bound to the consequential action, so that genomic personal data is governed at the action boundary, not after.

An AI-generated genomic design MUST remain advisory and MUST NOT drive a consequential action until a named human reviewer — an institutional biosafety committee (IBC), a CLIA / ISO 15189 laboratory director, or a designated responsible person — records oversight sign-off. Unreviewed AI-driven consequential actions are refused and routed dual-channel.

KYE governs WHETHER an AI-generated genomic sequence may proceed to a consequential action and PROVES the basis. KYE does not design sequences, fold proteins, run the screening pipeline, interpret clinical genomic results, or judge the scientific validity of a design.
